'''Doshian jellyfish''' were marine invertebrates native to [[Trandosha/Legends|Trandosha]]. They were widely considered to be the [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan's]] favorite food.

Many homesick Trandoshan travelers used to carry around a jellyfish [[Hologram/Legends|hologram]].

==Behind the scenes==
Jellyfish holograms are often found on killed Trandoshans on the [[Avatar Orbital Platform]] in ''Rage of the Wookiees'', the second expansion of the MMORPG [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']].
